WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCRUED_DMD_AMT)),0) ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),DMD_AMT)),0) DMD_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TOT_ADJ_AMT)),0) TOT_ADJ_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TOT_REFUND_AMT)),0) TOT_REFUND_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),WAIVED_AMT)),0) WAIVED_AMT_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAPENALDMD WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,ACCRUED_DMD_AMT ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_src
,DMD_AMT DMD_AMT_src
,TOT_ADJ_AMT TOT_ADJ_AMT_src
,TOT_REFUND_AMT TOT_REFUND_AMT_src
,WAIVED_AMT WAIVED_AMT_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAPENALDMD WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_src
,DMD_AMT_src
,TOT_ADJ_AMT_src
,TOT_REFUND_AMT_src
,WAIVED_AMT_src
,ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_tgt
,DMD_AMT_tgt
,TOT_ADJ_AMT_tgt
,TOT_REFUND_AMT_tgt
,WAIVED_AMT_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_src
,CAST(DMD_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) DMD_AMT_src
,CAST(TOT_ADJ_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) TOT_ADJ_AMT_src
,CAST(TOT_REFUND_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) TOT_REFUND_AMT_src
,CAST(WAIVED_AMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) WAIVED_AMT_src
,CAST(ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_tgt
,CAST(DMD_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) DMD_AMT_tgt
,CAST(TOT_ADJ_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) TOT_ADJ_AMT_tgt
,CAST(TOT_REFUND_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) TOT_REFUND_AMT_tgt
,CAST(WAIVED_AMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) WAIVED_AMT_tgt
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_src
,DMD_AMT_src
,TOT_ADJ_AMT_src
,TOT_REFUND_AMT_src
,WAIVED_AMT_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,ACCRUED_DMD_AMT_tgt
,DMD_AMT_tgt
,TOT_ADJ_AMT_tgt
,TOT_REFUND_AMT_tgt
,WAIVED_AMT_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
